title: laya.v1
description: The System-1 decision-scan wire: agent-api (or any lane service) POSTs a speaker-attributed transcript to the laya service's /v1/scan/decision and gets back decision-candidate windows with scores. The judge is opaque — the contract is the scan wire only. Provenance (checkpoint id, elapsed) rides the response so callers can attribute a scan (P21: report state from evidence).

ts.description: utterance start timestamp as it should be echoed in candidates, e.g. 00:14:19

speaker.description: speaker name; empty when the source has no diarization

language.description: caller-supplied language (transcript.v1 per-segment language, majority) — echoed, never re-detected

threshold.description: min P(decision) for a window to be a candidate; service default when absent

top_k.description: max candidates returned, best-first; service default when absent

text.description: the window text the score refers to

checkpoint.description: provenance: which head scored this scan

elapsed_ms.description: wall time of the judge calls
